name: Kee Ming Group Berhad
overview: Kee Ming Group Berhad 于2026年2月12日在ACE Market上市，首次公开募股（IPO）涉及82,875,000股普通股。年内，公司及其子公司与关联方Atlantic Blue Sdn. Bhd.进行了经常性关联交易，累计金额超过RM1.0百万。公司业务线未发生扩张、缩减或退出，亦未获得新合约。
overview_en: Kee Ming Group Berhad was listed on the ACE Market on 12 February 2026, with an initial public offering (IPO) of 82,875,000 ordinary shares. During the year, the company and its subsidiary entered into recurrent related party transactions with Atlantic Blue Sdn. Bhd., a connected party, with aggregate consideration exceeding RM1.0 million. There were no expansions, reductions, or exits of business lines, and no new contracts were secured.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司于2026年2月12日在ACE Market上市，并披露了与关联方的经常性交易。
segments.note_en: The company was listed on the ACE Market on 12 February 2026 and disclosed recurrent related party transactions.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司Kee Ming Electrical Sdn. Bhd.在正常业务过程中与关联方Atlantic Blue Sdn. Bhd.进行经常性关联交易，自2026年2月12日（上市日）至2026年6月5日累计交易金额超过RM1.0百万及1.0%比率。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Kee Ming Electrical Sdn. Bhd. entered into recurrent related party transactions with Atlantic Blue Sdn.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") OF 82,875,000 ORDINARY SHARES IN KEE MING GROUP BERHAD ("KEE MING" OR "COMPANY") ("SHARES") COMPRISING PUBLI
actions.text: 公司进行首次公开募股（IPO），涉及82,875,000股普通股，包括公开发行66,625,000股新股及献售16,250,000股现有股份，并于2026年2月12日在ACE Market上市。
actions.text_en: The company undertook an initial public offering (IPO) of 82,875,000 ordinary shares, comprising a public issue of 66,625,000 new shares and an offer for sale of 16,250,000 existing shares, and was listed on the ACE Market on 12 February 2026.
